excludePrivate+liveOnly.sql: SELECT DISTINCT tag FROM tags WHERE page_id IN (SELECT id FROM pages WHERE slug = $1 AND source_id = $2 AND (COALESCE(pages.frontmatter->>'visibility', CASE WHEN (pages.type = 'atom' OR (pages.type = 'concept' AND pages.frontmatter->>'synthesized_by' IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'private' ELSE 'world' END) <> 'private' AND NOT (CASE WHEN pages.type = 'atom' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pages derived_origin WHERE derived_origin.source_id = pages.source_id AND derived_origin.slug = pages.frontmatter->>'source_slug' AND derived_origin.frontmatter->>'visibility' = 'private') WHEN (pages.type = 'atom' OR (pages.type = 'concept' AND pages.frontmatter->>'synthesized_by' IS NOT NULL)) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM links derived_input_link JOIN pages derived_input ON derived_input.id = derived_input_link.to_page_id WHERE derived_input_link.from_page_id = pages.id AND derived_input_link.link_source = 'concept-provenance' AND derived_input_link.link_type = 'synthesized_from' AND (COALESCE(derived_input.frontmatter->>'visibility', CASE WHEN derived_input.type = 'atom' THEN 'private' ELSE 'world' END) = 'private' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pages derived_input_origin WHERE derived_input_origin.source_id = derived_input.source_id AND derived_input_origin.slug = derived_input.frontmatter->>'source_slug' AND derived_input_origin.frontmatter->>'visibility' = 'private'))) ELSE false END)) AND deleted_at IS NULL) ORDER BY tag
